_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::reduced_airways#6, and the execution that FALSIFIED its Signal. Neither 'unknown element type for ELEMENT_BLOCK X' nor 'elementType BEAM3R has no RedAirway implementation' is emitted by 4C; both counters come out 0. What is really emitted: REDAIRWAY (the spelling the entry itself used) -> "Unknown type 'REDAIRWAY' of finite element" from core/comm/src/4C_comm_parobjectfactory.cpp; BEAM3R -> "Required 'one_of' not found in input line" from the element reader, never reaching runtime; RED_AIRWAY -> the acinus TYPE is rejected with the list of real airway TYPEs. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C on upstream deck red_airway_one_acinus_NeoHookean.4C.yaml.
expect_in_output: Required 'one_of' not found in input line

_mutation.note: remove the wrong-element-name pathology: keep RED_ACINUS in the arm that used REDAIRWAY. The ParObject factory diagnostic vanishes, EXIT_REDAIRWAY becomes 0, and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/1 RED_ACINUS LINE2/1 REDAIRWAY LINE2/'  base.yaml > redairway.yaml

_mutation.note: remove the beam-element pathology: keep RED_ACINUS in the BEAM3R arm. The element-reader abort vanishes, EXIT_BEAM becomes 0, and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/1 RED_ACINUS LINE2/1 BEAM3R LINE2/'     base.yaml > beam.yaml

_mutation.note: remove the airway/acinus mix-up: keep RED_ACINUS where RED_AIRWAY was substituted. The TYPE enumeration vanishes, EXIT_REDAIR becomes 0, and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/1 RED_ACINUS LINE2/1 RED_AIRWAY LINE2/' base.yaml > redair.yaml
